title: Actions Are By Intention
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-awwal ʿan Amīr al-muʾminīn Abī Ḥafṣ ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb raḍiya -llāhu ʿanhu qāla: samiʿtu Rasūl Allāh ṣallā -llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam yaqūl: "Innamā al-aʿmāl bin-niyyāt wa-innamā likulli imriʾin mā naway. Fa-man kānat hijratuhu ilā llāh wa-rasūlihi fa-hijratuhu ilā llāh wa-rasūlihi, wa-man kānat hijratuhu li-dunyā yuṣībuha aw imraʾah yankihuha fa-hijratuhu ilā mā hājar ilayhi." Rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa-Muslim.

title: The Levels of the Religion
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīthu ath-thānī ʿan ʿUmar رضي الله عنه ʾaydhan qāʾidhan baynama naḥnu julūs ʿinda Rasūlillāh صلى الله عليه وسلم dhāt yawmin iḏa ṭalaʿa ʿalaynā rajulun shadīd bayāḍ ath-thiyāb shadīd suwād ash-shaʿr lā yurā ʿalayhi athar as-safar walā yuʿrafuhu minnā aḥad ḥattā jalasa ilā an-Nabī صلى الله عليه وسلم fa-ʾasnad rakbatayhi ilā rakbatayhi wa-waḍaʿa kafayhi ʿalā fakhdhayhi wa-qāla yā Muḥammad ʾakhbirnī ʿan al-ʾIslām fa-qāla Rasūlullāh صلى الله عليه وسلم al-ʾIslām ʾan tashhadda ʾan lā ʾilāha ʾillā llāh wa-ʾanna Muḥammadan Rasūlullāh wa-tuqīmaṣ-ṣalāta wa-tuʾti az-zakāta wa-taṣūma Ramaḍān wa-tuḥujja al-bayta ʾin isṭaṭaʿta ʾilayhi sabīlā qāla sadaqta fa-ʿajabnā lahu yasʾaluhu wa-yuṣaddiquhu qāla fa-ʾakbirnī ʿan al-ʾīmān qāla ʾan tuʾmina bi-llāhi wa-malāʾikatihi wa-kutubihi wa-rusulihi wa-al-yawm al-ʾākhir wa-tuʾmin bi-l-qadari khayrihi wa-sharrihi qāla sadaqta qāla fa-ʾakhbirnī ʿan al-ʾiḥsān qāla ʾan taʿbuda llāha kaʾannaka tarāhu fa-in lam takun tarāhu fa-ʾinnahū yurāka qāla fa-ʾakhbirnī ʿan as-saʿy qāla mā al-masʾūlu ʿanhā bi-aʿlam mina s-sāʾil qāla fa-ʾakhbirnī ʿan ʾamārātihā qāla ʾan taluda al-ʾumatu rabbatahā wa-ʾan tarā al-ḥufāta al-ʿurāt al-ʿālahu ruʿā ash-shāʻi yataṭāwalūna fī al-bināʾ thumma inṭalaqa falabiso malyan thumma qāla yā ʿUmar atadrī man as-sāʾil qultu llāh wa-rasūluhu aʿlam qāla fa-ʾinnahū Jibrīl ʾatākum yuʿallimukum dīnakum rawāhu Muslim

title: The Five Pillars of Islām
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-thālith ʿan Abī ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhumā qāla: samiʿtu Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam yaqūl fani al-islām ʿalā khams: shahādatu ʾan lā ʾilāha ʾillā Allāh wa ʾan Muḥammadan Rasūlu Allāh wa iqāmat aṣ-ṣalāh wa ʾitāʾ az-zakāh wa ḥajj al-bayt wa ṣawm Ramaḍān. Rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa Muslim.

title: The Stages of Creation
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-rābiʿ ʿan Abī ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ʿAbdallāh ibn Masʿūd raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu qāla ḥaddathanā Rasūlullāh ﷺ wa huwa al-ṣādiq al-maṣdūq: Inna aḥadakum yajmaʿu khalqahu fī baṭn ʾummihi arbaʿīna yawm an-naṭfah thumma yakūn ʿalaqah mithla dhālik thumma yakūn muḍghah mithla dhālik thumma yursalu ilayhi al-malak fayanfaḫ fīhi al-rūḥ wa yuʾmaru bi arbaʿ kalimāt yuktabu rizquhu wa ajluhu wa ʿamaluhu wa shaqiyyun ʾaw saʿīd. Fa-llāhi alladhī lā ʾilāha ghayruhu inna aḥadakum la yaʿmalu biʿamali ahl al-jannah ḥattā mā yakūna baynahu wa baynahā ʾillā dirāʿun fa yusbiqu ʿalayhi al-kitāb fa yaʿmal biʿamali ahl al-nār fa yadkhuluhā, wa inna aḥadakum la yaʿmalu biʿamali ahl al-nār ḥattā mā yakūna baynahu wa baynahā ʾillā dirāʿun fa yusbiqu ʿalayhi al-kitāb fa yaʿmal biʿamali ahl al-jannah fa yadkhuluhā. Rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa Muslim.

title: Censure of Innovation
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-khāmis ʿan Umm al-muʾminīn Umm ʿAbdullāh ʿĀʾisha raḍiya -llāhu ʿanhā qālat: Qāla Rasūlullāh ṣallā -llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: "Man aḥdatha fī amrinā hādhā mā laysa minhu fa-huwa radd." Rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa Muslim wa fī riwāyah limuslim: "Man ʿamila ʿamalan laysa ʿalayhi amrunā fa-huwa radd."

title: The Doubtful Matters
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-sādis ʿan Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Naʿmād ibn Bashīr raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhumā qāl: samiʿtu Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam yaqūl: "Inna al-ḥalāl bayyin wa-inna al-ḥarām bayyin wa-baynuhumā umūr mushtabihat lā yaʿlamuhā kathīr min al-nās fa-man iṭtaqā al-shubuhāt faqad istabarra li-dīnīhi wa-ʿarḍihi wa-man waqaʿa fī al-shubuhāt waqaʿa fī al-ḥarām ka-al-rāʿī yarʿā ḥawla al-ḥimmā yūshiku an yartʻa fīhi alā wa-inna likulli malik ḥimmā alā wa-inna ḥimmā Allāh maḥārimuhu alā wa-innahā fī al-jasad miḍāʿ, idhā ṣalaḥat ṣalaḥa al-jasad kulluhu wa-idha fasadat fasada al-jasad kulluhu alā wa-hiya al-qalb." Rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa-Muslim.

title: Sincerity of Purpose
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-sābiʿ ʿan Abī Ruqayya Tamīm ibn Aws al-Dārī raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu anna al-nabī ṣalla llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam qāla: "Al-dīn al-naṣīḥa." Qulnā: "Liman?" Qāla: "Lillāh wa-l-kitābihi wa-li-rusulihi wa-li-aʾimmah al-muslimīn wa-ʿāmmatihim." Rawāhu Muslim.

title: The Inviolability of a Muslim
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-thāmin ʿan Ibn ʿUmar raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhumā ʾanna Rasūl Allāhi ṣalla Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam qāla ʾumirtu ʾan uqātila al-nāsa ḥattā yashhadu ʾanna lā ʾilāha ʾillā Allāh wa-ʾanna Muḥammadan Rasūlu Allāh wa-yaqīma al-ṣalāta wa-yuʾti al-zakāta fa-ʾidhā faʿalū dhālika ʿuṣimū minnī dmāʾahum wa-ʾamwālahum ʾillā bi-ḥaqqi al-islām wa-ḥisābuhum ʿalā Allāh taʿālā. Rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa-Muslim.

title: Too Much Questioning
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-tāsiʿ ʿan Nabī Hurayra ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ṣakhar raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu qāl samiʿtu Rasūl Allāh ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam yaqūl mā nahaytum ʿanhu fajtanibūhu wa-mā amartukum bihi fa-atū minhu mā istaṭaʿtum fa-innamā ahlak alladhīna min qablakum kathrat masāʾirihim wa-ikhtilāfahum ʿalā anbiyāʾihim. Rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa-Muslim.

title: The Answered Supplication
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-ʿāshir ʿan Abī Hurayrah raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu qāla qāla Rasūlu llāhi ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: Inna llāha taʿālā ṭayyib lā yaqbal illā ṭayyiban, wa-inna llāha amara al-muʾminīn bimā amara bihi al-mursalīn, faqāla taʿālā: Yāayyuhā al-rusul kulū min al-ṭayyibāt wa-aʿmalū ṣāliḥan. Wa-qāla taʿālā: Yāayyuhā allaḏīna āmanū kulū min ṭayyibāt mā razaqnākum. Thumma dhakara al-rajul yaṭīlu al-safar ašʿath aghbar yamuddu yadayhi ilā al-samāʾ yā rabb yā rabb, wa maṭʿamuhu ḥarām wa mashrubuhu ḥarām wa malbasuhu ḥarām wa ghudhiyya bil-ḥarām fa-annā yustajābu lahu. Rawāhu Muslim.

title: Leaving Doubt
narrator: al-Ḥasan bin ʿAlī bin Abī Ṭālib
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-ḥādī ʿashar ʿan Abī Muḥammad al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib ṣabbat Rasūl Allah ṣalla llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam wa rīḥānatihi raḍiya llāhu ʿanhumā qāla ḥafiẓtu min Rasūl Allah ṣalla llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam daʿ mā yurayyibuka ilā mā lā yurayyibuka rawāhu al-Tirmidhī wa al-Nasāʾī wa qāla al-Tirmidhī ḥadīth ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ

title: Interest in the Beneficial
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth ath-thānī ʿashar ʿan Abī Hurayrah raḍiya allāhu ʿanhu qāla qāla Rasūl Allāh ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: "Man ḥusna islām al-marʾ tarkahu mā lā yaʿnīhi." Ḥadīth ḥasan rawāhu at-Tirmidhī wa ghayruhu hakadhā.

title: From the Perfection of Īmān
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-thālith ʿashar ʿan Abī Ḥamza Anas bin Mālik raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhu khādim Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam ʿan al-nabī ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam qāla: Lā yu’minu aḥadukum ḥattā yuḥibba li-akhīhi mā yuḥibbu li-nafsihi. Rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa Muslim.

title: Sanctity of a Muslim's Life
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-rābiʿ ʿashar ʿan ibn Masʿūd raḍiya -llāhu ʿanhu qāla qāla Rasūlu -llāhi ṣallā -llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: Lā yaḥillu damu ʾimrin muslimin ʾillā biʾiḥdā thalāth: al-thayyibu al-zānī, wa al-nafsu bil-nafsi, wa al-tārik lidīnihi al-mufāriq li-l-jamāʿah. Rāwah al-Bukhārī wa Muslim.

title: Honouring the Guest
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-khāmis ʿashar ʿan Abī Hurayrah raḍiya Llāhu ʿanhu ʾanna Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam qāla: man kāna yuʾminu bi Llāhi wa l-yawm al-ākhir falyaqul khayran ʾaw liyasmut, wa man kāna yuʾminu bi Llāhi wa l-yawm al-ākhir falyukrim jārah, wa man kāna yuʾminu bi Llāhi wa l-yawm al-ākhir falyukrim ḍayfahu. Rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa Muslim.

title: Prohibition of Anger
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-sādis ʿashar ʿan Abī Hurayrah raḍiya Llāhu ʿanhu anna rajulan qāla lil-nabī ṣallā Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-ālihī wa-sallam ūṣinī qāla lā taghḍab farrada marrāran qāla lā taghḍab, rawāhu al-Bukhārī.

title: Kindness to Animals
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-sābiʿ ʿashar ʿan Abī Yaʿlā Shaddād ibn Aws raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu ʿan Rasūl llāh ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam qāla: "Inna llāha kataba al-iḥsān ʿalā kulli shayʾ fa-idhā qutiltum fa-aḥsinū al-qatla wa-idhā labbahtum fa-aḥsinū al-zabḥa wa-liyaḥud ʾaḥadukum shafartahu wa-liyarḥa dhabīḥatahu." Rawāhu Muslim.

title: Taqwā and Good Manners
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-thāmin ʿashar ʿan Abī Dharr Jundub ibn Junādah wa Abī ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Muʿādh ibn Jabal raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhumā ʿan Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam qāla: Ittaqi Allāha ḥaythumā kunt wa attabiʿ al-sayyiʾah al-ḥasan tatmahha wa khāliq al-nās bikhuluqin ḥasan. Rawāhu al-Tirmidhī wa qāla al-ḥadīth ḥasan wa fī baʿḍ al-nusakh ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ.

title: Faith in al-Qaḍā wal-Qadar
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-tāsiʿ ʿashar ʿan Abī al-ʿAbbās ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās raḍiya llāhu ʿanhumā qāla kuntu khalf al-nabī ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam yawman fa-qāla yā ghulām innī aʿallimuka kalimāt iḥfaẓ llāh yaḥfaẓuk iḥfaẓ llāh tajidhu tijāhak idhā saʾalta fasʾal llāh wa idhā istaʿanta fastaʿin bi-llāh wa ʿalim anna al-ummah law ijtamaʿat ʿalā an yanfaʿūka bishayʾ lam yanfaʿūka illā bishayʾ qad katabahu llāh laka wa in ijtamaʿū ʿalā an yaḍurrūka bishayʾ lam yaḍurrūka illā bishayʾ qad katabahu llāhu ʿalayka rufiʿat al-aqlām wa jafat al-ṣuḥuf rawāhu al-Tirmidhī wa qāla ḥadīth ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ wa fī riwāyah ghayr al-Tirmidhī iḥfaẓ llāh tajidhu amāmaka taʿraf ilā llāh fī al-rakhāʾ yaʿrifuka fī al-shiddah wa ʿalim anna mā akhṭāk lam yakun l-yuṣībak wa mā aṣābak lam yakun l-yukhṭiak wa ʿalim anna al-naṣr maʿa al-ṣabr wa anna al-faraj maʿa al-karb wa anna maʿa al-ʿusr yusrā

title: Modesty, Shame is From Īmān
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-ʿishrūn ʿan Abī Masʿūd ʿUqbah ibn ʿUmar al-Anṣārī al-Badrī raḍiya Llāhu ʿanhu qāla qāla Rasūlullāh ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: "Inna mimmā adrak an-nās min kalām an-nubūwah al-ūlā idhā lam tastaḥ faṣnaʿ mā shi't." Rawāhu al-Bukhārī.

title: Having Istiqāmah Upon Islām
Arabic_Transliteration_text: al-Ḥadīth al-ḥādī wa-al-ʿishrūn ʿan Abī ʿAmr wa-qīla Abī ʿAmrah Sufyān ibn ʿAbdillāh raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu qāla qultu yā Rasūla llāh qul lī fī al-islām qawlan lā asʾalu ʿanhu aḥadan ghayraka qāla qul āmintu bi-llāhi thumma istaqim rawāhu Muslim

title: The Path to Paradise
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth ath-thānī wa-al-ʿishrūn ʿan Abī ʿAbd Allāh Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhumā anna rajulan saʾala Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-ālihī wa-sallama faqāla: "Araʾayta idhā ṣallaytu al-muktūbāt wa-ṣumtu Ramaḍān wa-aḥallaltu al-ḥalāl wa-ḥarramtu al-ḥarām wa-lam azal ʿalā dhālika shayʾan, a-adkhulu al-jannah?" Qāla: "Naʿam." Rawāhu Muslim. Wa-maʿnā ḥarramtu al-ḥarām ijtanabtuhu, wa-maʿnā aḥallaltu al-ḥalāl faʿaltuhu muʿtaqidan ḥillah.

title: Purity is Half of Īmān
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth ath-thālith wa-al-ʿishrūn ʿan Abī Mālik al-Ḥārith ibn ʿĀsim al-Ashʿarī raḍiya-llāhu ʿanhu qāla qāla Rasūlullāh ṣallā-llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: "Aṭ-ṭuhūr shiṭr al-īmān wal-ḥamdu lillāh tamlaʾu al-mīzān wa-subḥānallāh wal-ḥamdu lillāh tamlaʾu aw tamlānī mā bayna as-samāʾ wa-al-arḍ wa-ṣ-ṣalāh nūr wa-aṣ-ṣadaqah burhān wa-aṣ-ṣabr ḍiyāʾ wa-al-Qurʾān ḥujjah laka aw ʿalayka. Kullu an-nās yughdū fabāʾiʿu nafsahu fa-muʿtiquhā aw mūbiqahā." Rāwāhu Muslim.

title: Prohibition of Oppression
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-rābiʿ wa-al-ʿishrūn ʿan Abī Dharr al-Ghifārī radhiyallāhu ʿanhu ʿan al-nabiyy ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam fī mā yarwīhi ʿan rabbihi ʿazza wa-jalla annahu qāla: Yā ʿibādī innī ḥarramtu al-ẓulm ʿalā nafsī wa-jaʿaltuhu baynakum muḥarraman falā taẓālamū yā ʿibādī kullukum ḍālun illā man hadaytuhu fa-ista hdūnī ahdikum yā ʿibādī kullukum jāʾiʿun illā man aṭʿamtuhu fa-isṭʿimūnī uṭʿimkum yā ʿibādī kullukum ʿārin illā man kasawtuhu fasta ksūnī aksukum yā ʿibādī innakum tukhtaʾūna bi-al-layl wa-al-nahār wa-anā aghfiru al-dhunūba jamīʿan fa-istaġfirūnī aghfir lakum yā ʿibādī innakum lan tablughu ḍarri fatadurrūnī wa-lan tablughu nafʿī fatanfaʿūnī yā ʿibādī law anna awwalakum wa-ākhirakum wa-insakum wa-jinnakum kānū ʿalā atqā qalb rajulin wāḥidin minkum mā zāda dhālik fī mulkī shayʾan yā ʿibādī law anna awwalakum wa-ākhirakum wa-insakum wa-jinnakum kānū fī ṣaʿīd wāḥid fa-saʾalūnī fa-aʿṭaytu kulla wāḥidin masʾalatahu mā naqaṣa dhālik mimmā ʿindī illā kamā yanquṣu al-mikhyāṭ idhā udkhila al-baḥr yā ʿibādī innamā hiya aʿmālukum aḥṣīhā lakum thumma awfīkum iyyāhā faman wajada khayran faliyaḥmadillāh wa-man wajada ghayra dhālik falā yalumni illā nafsahu. Rawāhu Muslim.

title: The Excellence of Dhikr
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-khāmis wa-al-ʿishrūn ʿan Nabiyyin Dhurrin raḍiya-llāhu ʿanhu ayyḍan anna nāsan min aṣḥābi Rasūli-llāh ṣallā-llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam qālū li-nnabī ṣallā-llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam yā Rasūla-llāh dhahaba ahlu al-duthūr bil-ujūr yuṣallūna kamā nuṣallī wa-yaṣūmūna kamā naṣūm wa-yataṣaddaqūna bifaḍūli amwālihim qāla ʾawalaysa qad jaʿala-llāhu lakum mā taṣaddaqūna inna lakum bikuulli tasbīḥatin ṣadaqatin wa-kuulli takbīratin ṣadaqatin wa-kuulli taḥmīdatin ṣadaqatin wa-kuulli tahlīlatin ṣadaqatin wa-ʾamrin bil-maʿrūfi ṣadaqatin wa-nahyin ʿan munkarin ṣadaqatin wa-fī buḍʿi aḥadikum ṣadaqatin qālū yā Rasūla-llāh ʾayāṭī ʾaḥadunā shahwatahu wa-yakūnu lahu fīhā ajr qāla ʾaraʾaytum law waḍaʿahā fī ḥarāmin ʾakāna ʿalayhi wuzr fa-kaḏālika iḏā waḍaʿahā fī al-ḥalāli kāna lahu ajr rawāhu Muslim

title: The Paths of Goodness
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth as-sādis wa-al-ʿishrūn ʿan Abī Hurayrah raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu qāla qāla Rasūlu llāhi ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam kullu salāmin mina nnāsi ʿalayhi ṣadaqah kullu yawmin taṭlaʿu fīhi ash-shamsu taʿdilu bayna ithnayn ṣadaqah wataʿīn al-rajuli fī dābatihi fataḥmiluhu ʿalayhā aw tarfaʿu lahu ʿalayhā matāʿahu ṣadaqah wa-al-kalimatu ṭ-ṭayyibatu ṣadaqah wabi-kulli khuṭwah tamshīhā ilā ṣ-ṣalāh ṣadaqah wata’mītu al-adha ʿan aṭ-ṭarīq ṣadaqah rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa-Muslim

title: Righteousness and Sin
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-sābiʿ wa-al-ʿishrūn ʿan al-Nawwās ibn Samʿān raḍiyay Allāhu ʿanhu ʿan al-nabiyyi ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam qāla: al-birr ḥusnu al-khuluqi wal-ithm mā ḥāka fī nafsika wa-kurihta an yaṭṭaliʿa ʿalayhi al-nās. Rawāhu Muslim wa-ʿAwābiṣah ibn Muʿabbad raḍiyay Allāhu ʿanhu qāla: ataytu Rasūl Allāhi ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam fa-qāla: jiʾta tasʾalu ʿan al-birr? qulta: naʿam. Qāla: istifti qalbaka, al-birr māṭmiʾnah ilayhi al-nafs wa-iṭmaʾanna ilayhi al-qalb wal-ithm mā ḥāka fī al-nafs wa-taraddada fī al-ṣadr. Wa-in aftāka al-nās wa-aftāk. Ḥadīth ḥasan, rawaynahū fī musnadī al-imāmī Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal wa-al-Dārimī bi-isnād ḥasan.

title: Sticking to the Sunnah
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-thāmin wa-al-ʿishrūn wa-ʿan Nabī Najīḥ al-ʿIrbāḍ ibn Sāriyyah raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhu qāla: waʿaẓanā Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam mawʿiẓatan wajallat minhā al-qulūb wa-dharafat minhā al-ʿuyūn fa-qulnā yā Rasūl Allāh ka-annahā mawʿiẓatu mūdāʿin fa-awṣanā qāla: awṣīkum bi-taqwā Allāh ʿazza wa-jall wa-al-samʿ wa-al-ṭāʿah wa-in tuʾmir ʿalaykum ʿabdun fa-innahu man yaʿish minkum fa-sayara ikhtilāfan kathīran fa-ʿalaykum bi-sunnatī wa-sunnati al-khulafāʾ al-rāshidīn al-muhaddīn, ʿaḍḍū ʿalayhā bi-al-nawājid wa-iyyākum wa-muḥdathāt al-umūr fa-inna kulla bidʿatin ḍalālah. Rawāhu Abū Dāwūd wa-al-Tirmidhī wa-qāla ḥadīthun ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ.

title: The Danger of the Tongue
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-tāsiʿ wa-al-ʿishrūn: ʿAm ʿĀdh ibn Jabal raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhu qāla: Qultu yā Rasūl Allāh akhbirnī bi-ʿamalٍ yadkhulunī al-jannah wa-yubāʿidunī ʿan al-nār. Qāla: Laqad saʾalta ʿan ʿaẓīm, wa-innahū yasīr ʿalā man yasarrahu Allāh taʿālā ʿalayhi: taʿbudu Allāha lā tushrif bihi shayʾan, wa-tuqqīmu al-ṣalāh, wa-tuʾtī al-zakāh, wa-taṣūmu Ramaḍān, wa-taḥujju al-bayt. Thumma qāla: Alā adnuka ʿalā abwābi al-khayr? Al-ṣaum junnah wa-al-ṣadaqah tuṭfiʾu al-khaṭīʾah kamā yuṭfiʾu al-māʾu al-nār, wa-ṣalāh al-rajul fī jawf al-layl. Thumma talā: Tatajāfā junūbuhum ʿan al-miḍājiʿ ḥattā balagh yuʿmalūn. Thumma qāla: Alā ukhbiruka bi-raʾs al-amr wa-ʿamūdih wa-dhurwat sināmah? Qultu balā yā Rasūl Allāh. Qāla: Raʾs al-amr al-islām, wa-ʿamūdahu al-ṣalāh, wa-dhurwat sināmah al-jihād. Thumma qāla: Alā ukhbiruka bimilāk dhālik kullih? Fa-qultu balā yā Rasūl Allāh. Fa-akhadha biliṣānahu wa-qāla: Kaff ʿalayka hādhā. Qultu: Yā nabī Allāh wa-innā lam nukhadhdh bimā natakallam bih. Fa-qāla: Thakallatki ummuki, wa-hal yukb al-nās fī al-nār ʿalā wujūhihim aw qāla ʿalā manākhirihim illā ḥaṣāʾid alsinatihim. Rawāhu al-Tirmidhī wa-qāla ḥadīthun ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ.

title: The Limits of the Sharīʿah
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-thalāthūn ʿan Abī Thaʿlabah al-Khushnī Jurthūm ibn Nāshir raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu ʿan Rasūl Allāh ﷺ qāla: "Inna llāha taʿālā faraḍa farāʾiḍa falā tuḍayyiʿūhā wa ḥadda ḥudūdan falā taʿtadūhā wa ḥarramaashyāʾa falā tantahikūhā wa sakata ʿan ashyāʾa raḥmatan lakum ghayra nisiyyan falā tabḥathū ʿanhā." Ḥadīth ḥasan rawāhu al-Dār Qutnī wa ghayruhu

title: Abstinence From the World
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-ḥādī wa-salāthūn ʿan Abī al-ʿAbbās Sahl ibn Saʿd al-Sāʿidī raḍiya -llāhu ʿanhu qāla jāʾa rajulun ilā al-nabī ṣallā -llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam faqāla yā rasūla -llāh dallinī ʿalā ʿamalin idhā ʿamilta-hu aḥbbanī -llāh wa aḥbbanī al-nās faqāla izhad fī al-dunyā yuḥibbuka -llāh wa izhad fīmā ʿinda al-nās yuḥibbuka al-nās ḥadīth ḥasan rawāhu Ibn Mājah wa ghayruhu bi-asānīd ḥasanah

title: There Should Be No Harm
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-thānī wa-al-thalāthūn ʿan Abī Saʿīd Saʿd ibn Sannān al-Khudrī raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu ʾanna Rasūl Allāh ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam qāla: Lā ḍarar wa-lā ḍirār. Ḥadīth ḥasan rawāhu Ibn Mājah wa-al-Dār Qutnī wa-ghayruhumā musnadan, wa-rawāhu Mālik fī al-Muwaṭṭāʾ mursalan ʿan ʿUmar ibn Yaḥyā ʿan abīhi ʿan al-nabī ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam. Fa-ʾasqaṭa Abā Saʿīd, wa-lahu ṭuruqun yuqawwī baʿḍuhā baʿḍan.

title: The Proof is Upon the Claimant
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth ath-thālith wa-thalāthūn ʿan Ibn ʿAbbās raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhumā anna Rasūl Allāh ṣalla Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam qāla: Law yuʿṭā an-nās biduʿāhim ladaʿā rijāl amwāl qawm wa-dimāʾahum, lākinna al-bayyinah ʿalā al-muddaʿī wa-al-yamīn ʿalā man ankara. Ḥadīth ḥasan rawāhu al-Bayhaqī wa-ghayruhu hākadhā wa-baʿḍuhu fī aṣ-ṣaḥīḥayn.

title: Correcting the Evil
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-rābiʿ wa-al-thalāthūn ʿan Abī Saʿīd al-Khudrī raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhu qāla: samiʿtu Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam yaqūl: man raʾā minkum munkaran falyughayyirhu biyadih fa-in lam yastaṭiʿ fa-bilisānihi fa-in lam yastaṭiʿ fa-bi-qalbihi wa-dhālik aḍʿaf al-īmān. Rāwāhu Muslim.

title: Brotherhood and Piety
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-khāmis wa-al-thalāthūn ʿan Abī Hurayrah raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhu qāla qāla Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: Lā tuḥāsidū wa-lā tunājishū wa-lā tabāghaḍū wa-lā tadābarū wa-lā yabīʿ baʿḍukum ʿalā bayʿ baʿḍin wa-kūnū ʿibād Allāh ikhwanā. Al-muslim akhū al-muslim, lā yaẓlimuhu wa-lā yakhdhiluhu wa-lā yukadhibuhu wa-lā yuḥaqqiruhu. At-taqwā hāhunā – wa-yushīru ilā ṣadrihi thalāth marrāt. Ḥasaba imriʾin mina al-sharri an yuḥaqqira akhāhu al-muslim. Kulla al-muslim ʿalā al-muslim ḥarāmun damuhu wa-mālahu wa-ʿarḍuhu. Rāwāhu Muslim.

title: Seeking Knowledge
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-sādis wal-thalāthūn ʿan Abī Hurayrah raḍiya -llāhu ʿanhu ʿan al-nabiyy ṣallā -llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam qāla: "Man naffasa ʿan muʾminin kurbah min kurab al-dunyā naffasa -llāhu ʿanhu kurbah min kurab yawm al-qiyāmah. Wa man yassara ʿalā muʿassir yassara -llāhu ʿalayhi fī al-dunyā wa al-ākhirah. Wa man sattara musliman sattarahu -llāhu fī al-dunyā wa al-ākhirah. Wa -llāhu fī ʿawn al-ʿabd mā kāna al-ʿabd fī ʿawn akhīhi. Wa man salaka ṭarīqan yaltamisu fīhi ʿilman sahhala -llāhu bihi ṭarīqan ilā al-jannah. Wa majmaʿu qawmin fī baytin min buyūt -llāh yatlūna kitāb -llāh wa yatadārasūnahu baynahum illā nazzalat ʿalayhim al-sakīnah wa ghashīthim al-raḥmah wa ḥafatihim al-malāʾikah wa dhakarahum -llāh fī man ʿindahu. Wa man baṭaʾa bihi ʿamluhu lam yusriʿ bihi nasabuhu." Rawāhu Muslim bihi hādhā al-lafẓ.

title: Righteous Deeds Explained
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-sābiʿ wa-al-thalāthūn ʿan Ibn ʿAbbās raḍiya llāhu ʿanhumā ʿan Rasūl Allāh ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam fīmā yarwīhi ʿan rabbihi tabāraka wa-taʿālā qāla: Inna llāha kataba al-ḥasanāt wa-al-sayyiʾāt thumma bayyana dhālika, fa-man hamma bi-ḥasana fa-lam yaʿmalhā katabahā llāhu ʿindahu ḥasana kāmila, wa-in hamma bihā fa-ʿamalahā katabahā llāhu ʿindahu ʿashara ḥasanāt ilā sabʿamiʾa ḍaʿf ilā aḍʿāf kathīra, wa-in hamma bi-sayyiʾa fa-lam yaʿmalhā katabahā llāhu ʿindahu ḥasana kāmila, wa-in hamma bihā fa-ʿamalahā katabahā llāhu sayyiʾa wāḥida. Rawāhu al-Bukhārī wa-Muslim fī ṣiḥḥayhimā bi-hādhihi al-ḥurūf.

title: The Awliyāʾ of Allāh
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-thāmin wa-al-thalāthūn ʿan Abī Hurayrah raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu qāla Rasūlu llāhi ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: Inna llāha taʿālā qāla man ʿādā lī walīyan faqad ādhantuhu bi-al-ḥarb wa-mā taqarraba ilayya ʿabdī bi-shay’in aḥabba ilayya mimmā iftaraḍtuhu ʿalayhi wa-la-yazālu ʿabdī yataqarrabu ilayya bi-al-nawāfil ḥattā uḥibbahu fa-idhā aḥbabtuhu kuntu samʿahu alladhī yasmaʿu bihi wa-baṣarahu alladhī yubṣiru bihi wa-yadahu allatī yabṭishu bihā wa-rijlahu allatī yamshī bihā wa-la’in sa-alanī la-uʿṭiyannah wa-la’in istaʿāḏanī la-uʿīḏannah. Rawāhu al-Bukhārī.

title: Mistakes and Forgetfulness
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth at-tāsiʿ wa-th-thalāthūn ʿan Ibn ʿAbbās raḍiya llāhu ʿanhumā anna Rasūl Allāh ṣalla llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam qāla: "Inna llāha tajāwaza lī ʿan ummati al-khaṭaʾ wa-n-nisyān wa-mā istiqarrū ʿalayhi." Ḥadīth ḥasan rawāhu Ibn Mājah wa-l-Bayhaqī wa-ghayruhumā ishtarakū fī al-qanāh

title: Be in the World as a Stranger
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-arbaʿūn ʿan Ibn ʿUmar raḍiya -llāhu ʿanhumā qāla: Akhdha Rasūlullāh ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam biman kabī fayaqūl: Kun fī al-dunyā kaʾannaka gharībun aw ʿābiru ṣabīl. Wa kāna Ibn ʿUmar raḍiya -llāhu ʿanhumā yaqūlu: Idhā amsayta fa-lā tantaẓir al-ṣabāḥ, wa idhā aṣbaḥta fa-lā tantaẓir al-masāʾ. Wakhudh min ṣiḥḥatika limaraḍika wa min ḥayātika limawtika. Rawāhu al-Bukhārī.

title: Following the Prophet
narrator: ʿAbd Allāh bin ʿAmr bin al-ʿĀṣ
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-hādī wa-al-arbaʿūn ʿan Abī Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhumā qāla qāla Rasūl Allāh ﷺ lā yuʾminu aḥadukum ḥattā yakūna hawāhu tabʿan limā jiʾtu bihi. Ḥadīth ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ, rawaynāhu fī kitāb al-ḥujjah bi-isnād ṣaḥīḥ.

title: Allāh's Vast Mercy
Arabic_Transliteration_text: Al-ḥadīth al-thānī wa-al-arbaʿūn ʿan Anas raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhu qāla samiʿtu Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam yaqūl qāla Allāh taʿālā yā ibn Ādam innaka mā daʿawtnī wa-rajtanī ghafartu laka ʿalā mā kāna minka wa-lā ubālī yā ibn Ādam law balaghat dhunūbuka ʿunānan al-samāʾ thumma istaghfartanī ghafartu laka yā ibn Ādam innaka law ataytani bi-qurābi al-arḍ khaṭāyā thumma laqītanī lā tushrik bī shayʾan la-ataytuka bi-qurābihā maghfirah. Rawāhu al-Tirmidhī wa-qāla ḥadīth ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ.
